prior_pending_row.question: On Passage
prior_pending_row.reason: Checkpoint 191 fully reads the complete 252-page July print and the 133,704-character Senate GENIUS text and confirms own July 17 passage identity. Existing Health shared core/ref/digests remain unchanged. No Immigration clearance, component member stance, new meaning/proposition, acceptance or enacted/current-law claim. S. 1582 ES has person including individuals and organizations, specified US formation and foreign financial domicile/registration/reciprocity conditions; these are not silently recast as citizenship/status. Section 8 retains qualified United States person secondary-trading waivers/licenses, distinct security/intelligence/law-enforcement exceptions and reporting. Section 5(i) AML/sanctions certifications reference INA section 219 designated organizations; that citation alone does not import alien admission/removal consequences. Financial approval revocation differs from immigration removal. Keep unresolved/noncounting pending materially affected individual-access/status definitions, incorporation and bounded Immigration application; no automatic domain fit/exclusion or universal exemption. Own question precedes voice ayes, Waters demand/order and postponement, followed later by recorded passage, 308-122 with two Not Voting; Foushee Nay and Massie Not Voting.
